groundTruth.title: What you know about your field
groundTruth.intro: What you measured or remember beats a satellite estimate. Add what you know; leave the rest empty.
groundTruth.seasons.heading: Each season
groundTruth.seasons.hint: Planting, harvest and yield for your confirmed seasons. Any yield unit works; ITZA only compares it with itself.
groundTruth.seasons.none: Confirm your field's history first, then you can add planting dates and yields per season.
groundTruth.irrigation.heading: Irrigation
groundTruth.irrigation.hint: Add each time you watered the field.
groundTruth.saved: Saved. Results and confidence now use what you entered.
groundTruth.error.irrigation: Enter both a date and an amount above zero for the irrigation.
groundTruth.log.heading: What you changed
groundTruth.log.none: You have not overridden anything yet. ITZA is using satellite and default values.
groundTruth.log.clearLabel: Clear {label} and go back to the satellite or default value
groundTruth.error.order: The harvest date for {label} must be after its planting date.
groundTruth.preview.heading: What this changes
groundTruth.preview.no-field: Draw your field on the map to see what your observations change.
groundTruth.preview.no-rotation: Confirm your field's history to replay it with your observations.
groundTruth.preview.loading-data: Loading the satellite data for your field.
groundTruth.preview.running: Replaying your field with what you entered.
groundTruth.preview.taw: Water the soil can hold in 1 m of roots
groundTruth.preview.note: Model-based counterfactual, not measured yield. Values you entered are used as given.
